title: Produce real CMS signatures with vetted crypto
notes: Library half of the signing pair per ADR 0012 (docs/decisions/0012-feature-tasks-split-library-and-shell.md). Serves acceptance item A-20 (signature with an E-signed badge only when the cryptographic check passes on an unmodified document) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Produces and validates real CMS/PKCS#7 signatures over the signed byte range using vetted crypto only, through the pdfxi-document session of ADR 0010, with tamper and wrong-certificate negative tests and a real fixture proof; T-0235 is the serialised shell task that shows the badge and owns crates/pdfxi-app/src/shell/**. Matrix rows stay `library` until that shell task verifies them.
